RA-B.title: Rear Centre Arch RA-B
RA-B.note:
Made in 2 parts (the head meets the
existing rear column):
RA-B front arch, 237 deep, stops 3 mm
in front of the column cladding.
RA-B-BL back sides, 305 deep, beside
the column, follow the arch curve up
to the LF-C soffit (+2.292).
CNC MDF 18 formers, 8 FR MDF skins,
painted. 40 solid oak arch front.

labels.text: Front arch RA-B (237) + back sides RA-B-BL (305), 3 mm joint
